subject: [PATCH 7.2.y] selftests/cgroup: account for zswap shrinker writeback

reviews.author: Sasha Levin
reviews.summary: The reviewer acknowledged the patch and queued it for 7.2 without providing any technical feedback or concerns.
reviews.raw_body:
> However, when the zswap shrinker is enabled, the victim cgroup can see

Queued for 7.2, thanks.

2026-10-01.patch_summary: The patch modifies the selftests/cgroup/test_zswap.c test to account for zswap shrinker writeback by comparing writeback values before and after an aggressor cgroup runs, ensuring that the victim cgroup did not perform additional writebacks. This change aims to fix a systematic failure case in some Meta CI tests.
